notes: §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR10: on an unsuccessful WRITE "the I-O status of the file-name associated with record-name-1 is updated and control is transferred according to the rules of the USE statement following the execution of any USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure applicable to the file-name", applicability being §1985:VII.4.6.4 GR5 (a file-name procedure, else one for the mode the file is open or being opened in, GR5e for EXTEND). EmitWrite emits the runtime WRITE (WriteRecord / WriteAdvancingRecord answer 48 for a file not open output or extend, 44 outside the VARYING bounds), the FILE STATUS store, then EmitUseHook, whose __IoCheck (EmitUseMachinery, EmitScopeTiers) runs the file-name procedure else the open-mode one and returns after the WRITE; the end-of-page imperatives are guarded by IoStatusClass.Successful. The open-mode tier now reads FileConnector.OpenModeView, whose statement mode is scoped to the OPEN (BeginOpen ... EndModeScope, PB5200/PB5261), which closes this row's old gap. Probes at 85 (work-rs-04/c5): e) after a failed OPEN EXTEND (35, USE ON EXTEND runs) a WRITE gives 48 and runs no procedure, as before any OPEN; after a failed OPEN OUTPUT (30, USE ON OUTPUT runs) the WRITE 48 runs none; a WRITE to a file open INPUT runs USE ON INPUT 48; d) a WRITE FROM to a closed LINAGE file runs the file-name USE with the record moved and neither end-of-page phrase; a) VARYING 3 TO 10 at lengths 2 and 11 runs USE 44, length 5 succeeds; c) USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION EC-I-O (COBOL0877/0878) and USE without PROCEDURE (COBOL0900) refused. The witness fails a WRITE to a file open for input under a file-name USE. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5200 and kb/Work PB5261 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-04.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-04-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 (1993 amendment): on an unsuccessful WRITE 'the I-O status of the file-name ... is updated and control is transferred according to the rules of the USE statement following the execution of any USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure applicable'. §2023:14.9.51.4 GR15 and GR1 set the I-O status of the write file connector and send control through 9.1.12; §2023:9.1.12 GR2 names the USE declarative, selected by §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3 and GR6, and §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7 returns control after it. But 9.1.12 puts first 'Statements in a WHEN phrase of an active PERFORM statement' (§2023:9.1.12 GR1), and GR6 runs the USE procedure only when the WRITE is outside an exception-checking PERFORM or no WHEN matched: a WRITE in an exception-checking PERFORM with a matching WHEN runs no USE procedure. 2023 accepts that program, 1985 refuses it, and the result differs: a case added, so CHANGED. (GR15's record-area words are another 1985 rule's.)
